# bide-anchor command reference

<!-- Generated by TestReference in anchor/awss3/cmd/bide-anchor from what the commands print for -h. Do not edit:
     run go test . -run TestReference -update in anchor/awss3/cmd/bide-anchor. CI fails when this page is stale. -->

bide-anchor verifies and exports the signed tree heads that the S3 Object Lock anchor (`anchor/awss3`) wrote to a bucket.
It is a separate program in the anchor module, so that the AWS SDK is not in `bide`:

```sh
go install github.com/bide-ai/bide/anchor/awss3/cmd/bide-anchor@latest
```

How the anchor works, the bucket and IAM setup, and what each check shows and does not show, are in
[the anchoring guide](../guides/anchoring.md). Flags take one dash, as in `bide`. Credentials and the region
come from the AWS SDK's default chain, never from flags; a server other than AWS is selected with
`AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3` and `-path-style`. Exit status is 0 for success, 1 for a head or object that did not verify
or a finding, and 2 for a usage error.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`bide-anchor verify`](#bide-anchor-verify) | offline: check every object in a directory of downloaded anchor objects |
| [`bide-anchor export`](#bide-anchor-export) | write the verified heads of one run or trail, one per line, for `bide audit -heads` |
| [`bide-anchor check`](#bide-anchor-check) | online, read-only: verify the heads and report how they are stored |

## bide-anchor verify

```
Usage of bide-anchor verify:
  -dir string
    	a directory of downloaded anchor objects
  -kind string
    	the tree kind: journal, or events for a notification or event trail (default "journal")
  -pubkey string
    	the log operator's public key (ed25519:<hex>, or a file holding it)
  -run string
    	only this run or trail ID (default: every one)
```

## bide-anchor export

```
Usage of bide-anchor export:
  -bucket string
    	read this anchor bucket (online, with read-only credentials)
  -dir string
    	read a directory of downloaded anchor objects (offline)
  -force
    	with -bucket: export even when the lock audit has findings
  -kind string
    	the tree kind: journal, or events for a notification or event trail (default "journal")
  -o string
    	write to this file instead of standard output
  -owner string
    	the 12-digit AWS account ID that owns the bucket (with -bucket)
  -path-style
    	use path-style addressing (a non-AWS server)
  -prefix string
    	the key prefix the anchor was configured with (default bide-anchor/)
  -pubkey string
    	the log operator's public key (ed25519:<hex>, or a file holding it)
  -run string
    	the run or trail ID
```

## bide-anchor check

```
Usage of bide-anchor check:
  -bucket string
    	read this anchor bucket (online, with read-only credentials)
  -kind string
    	the tree kind: journal, or events for a notification or event trail (default "journal")
  -owner string
    	the 12-digit AWS account ID that owns the bucket (with -bucket)
  -path-style
    	use path-style addressing (a non-AWS server)
  -prefix string
    	the key prefix the anchor was configured with (default bide-anchor/)
  -pubkey string
    	the log operator's public key (ed25519:<hex>, or a file holding it)
  -run string
    	the run or trail ID
```
